description: List a project's Incidents — open ones first, then the most recently closed; unresolved only by default, with includeResolved for incident archaeology over a since/until window and monitorId to ask about one Monitor. An Incident opens when a Monitor's consecutive failing Cycles reach its failure threshold, and closes after enough consecutive passes, or when the Monitor is disabled. Rows are lean; read one Incident's notifications, statuses, and cycle references with get_incident. The 'monitoring' topic covers how Incidents notify.

includeResolved.description: Include resolved Incidents too. Defaults to false: only open Incidents.

limit.description: How many Incidents to return (default 10, maximum 50).

monitorId.description: Only this Monitor's Incidents, as reported by list_monitors.

since.description: Only Incidents still active after this ISO-8601 instant (2026-08-26T00:00:00Z) or date (2026-08-26).

until.description: Only Incidents opened at or before this ISO-8601 instant or date.

name: list_incidents
title: List Incidents
